NCAA Freshman & Redshirt Freshman Champions
Winning an NCAA Division I wrestling title as a freshman is one of collegiate sports’ rarest achievements. This chart displays modern true freshman champions alongside notable redshirt freshman title winners.

title: Analysis Men’s NCAA Wrestling
text:
Top 10 teams by year
Each point shows a team’s championship points for that year, with the school logo and team name. Hover over a point for the coach and exact values. Click a logo to open the official NCAA brackets/results for that season; for 2015–2021, the link opens the NCAA championship history archive. Rankings and points are from the NCAA Division I wrestling records; logos are loaded from official athletics sites and their image CDNs.

title: Analysis Men’s NCAA Wrestling
section: Wrestler wins and losses by weight
text:
Wrestler wins and losses by weight
Choose a championship year and weight class to compare every wrestler in the NCAA bracket by their season wins and losses. Click a point to view the wrestler’s record and links to a bio search and the official bracket. The bracket data for 2022 and 2023–2025 are included; the 2020 tournament was canceled. The 2022 records are from the official NCAA bracket PDF.

title: Analysis Men’s NCAA Wrestling
section: Division II and III championship points
text:
Division II and III championship points
The Division II scatterplot compares the champion and runner-up from each of the last 10 completed championships (2015–2025; the 2020 championship was canceled). Scores are from the NCAA Division II championship history. Hover over a point for the team, placement, and points.
The Division III chart shows the top two scoring positions at each completed championship since 2015, including all teams tied for a position. The 2020 and 2021 championships were canceled. Scores are from the NCAA Division III championship history.
